paragraphs: From Killarney test centre on Ross Road, move off and continue along Ross Road for about 800 metres
Take the next right, still on Ross Road at the end of the road turn left onto Muckross Road
Take the 1st right onto Countess Road follow Countess Road
Turn right into Countess Grove and take the next right into Bluebells Drive to practice a stop
Move off again on Bluebells Drive, carry out a turnabout (U-turn) safely, and return along Bluebells Drive
Turn left onto Countess Grove, then at the end of the road turn right onto Countess Road
Follow it for nearly a kilometre up to the roundabout
At the roundabout take the slight left exit onto Park Road and continue straight through, following Park Road to the next roundabout on the Killarney Bypass
Take the left exit to join the Killarney Bypass, then at the following roundabout take the slight left exit to stay on the bypass
Continue on the Killarney Bypass for around 2 kilometres of steady dual-carriageway driving
At the next roundabout take the left exit onto Doctor Hans Liebherr Road, then at the following roundabout take the left exit onto Port Road
Continue on Port Road, which becomes Mission Road straight ahead, and follow it to the roundabout at The Haha
Take the slight left exit to stay on The Haha
Turn right onto Ross Road take the next left into Castle Falls
Follow Castle Falls around, taking the right turns to complete a loop, and pull in briefly on the unnamed section for a manoeuvre such as a reverse around the corner
Move off again and turn right back onto Ross Road
At the end of the road turn left onto Muckross Road, then at the roundabout continue straight onto East Avenue Road and take the slight left exit at the next rotary
At the end of the road turn left onto the R876, then slight left to stay on the R876
Take the next right onto Lewis Road, left into Mangerton View, right onto O'Connell's Terrace, and left onto Sunnyhill, following it round to finish on the right
From here it is a short drive back along Muckross Road and Ross Road to return to the Killarney test centre
